update_bn_stats: recompute batch norm statistics on a model using a fixed number of training samples
scaled_all_reduce: perform distributed all-reduce on tensors and scale results by the inverse number of GPUs
PreciseBNHook_init: create a PreciseBNHook with a configurable number of samples and interval for precise BN updates
PreciseBNHook_after_train_epoch: trigger precise BN recomputation after every N epochs during epoch-based training
PreciseBNHook_after_train_iter: trigger precise BN recomputation after every N iterations during iteration-based training
